title: PowerToys Workspaces fails to correctly capture WSLg application window positions

judgment.rationale: The report provides a useful environment and setup but no observable mismatch, so maintainers cannot distinguish capture-time coordinates, persisted workspace data, and restore-time placement.
evidence: The report uses Microsoft Store PowerToys 0.101.2632.0 and 0.101.2652.
The scenario uses a WSL instance and a Linux GUI application such as Edge through WSLg.
The reporter repeats capture and save operations after moving/resizing the window.
Expected behavior, actual behavior, and additional information are blank.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with one concrete window position/size before capture and the position/size shown after restore.

information_gaps.information: Fresh diagnostics captured immediately after reproducing the mismatch.

comment.body:
Please provide:
1. One concrete before/after example with the window position and size before capture, the values shown in the saved workspace if visible, and the position and size after restore; also say whether the mismatch occurs during capture, restore, or both.
2. Reproduce the mismatch and add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward.
This will distinguish a WSLg window-identity/coordinate-capture issue from a restore-placement issue.
